input: Find a reputable pet groomer near my home

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Different pets (dog, cat, rabbit, etc.) have vastly different grooming needs and require specialists — this changes which groomers are even relevant.
The pet's breed, size, age, and temperament (e.g., anxious, elderly) directly affect what type of groomer or grooming style is appropriate.
The user's location or neighborhood is essential to define what 'near home' means and to surface accurate local results.
Budget per grooming session determines which services or salons are realistic options and filters out mismatches.
The user may have strong preferences about mobile vs. in-salon grooming, or specific services needed (bath only, full groom, nail trim), which shapes the search entirely.
What 'reputable' means varies — some prioritize online reviews, certifications, fear-free practices, or word-of-mouth recommendations. This defines how to evaluate options.
Knowing whether the user needs a one-time appointment or a recurring groomer, and how soon, affects urgency and whether availability is a deciding factor.

gold.taskTitle: Find a reputable pet groomer near home
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and choose a trustworthy, nearby grooming service for their pet.

questions.title: What type of pet needs grooming?
questions.description: Identify the species of the pet (e.g., dog, cat, rabbit) to narrow the search to groomers who specialize in that animal.

questions.title: What is your pet's breed, size, and age?
questions.description: Capture breed, size, and age details to match groomers experienced with the pet's specific coat type, physical needs, or temperament.

questions.title: What city, neighborhood, or zip code are you in?
questions.description: Establish the user's location to define a meaningful search radius for 'near home.'

questions.title: What is your budget per grooming session?
questions.description: Understand the acceptable price range per visit to filter out options that are too expensive or to flag unusually cheap ones.

questions.title: Do you prefer mobile grooming or a salon visit?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a groomer who comes to their home or a traditional brick-and-mortar salon, as this changes the entire search approach.

questions.title: What does 'reputable' most mean to you here?
questions.description: Clarify the user's trust signals — e.g., high star ratings, certified groomers, fear-free handling, personal referrals — to prioritize correctly when comparing options.

questions.title: Do you need a one-time or recurring grooming appointment?
questions.description: Find out whether this is a single visit or an ongoing relationship, which affects how much weight to give availability, scheduling flexibility, and loyalty pricing.
